title: atlas.control.preemption.v1
description: A lock/unlock lifecycle event from the Preemption Overlay (docs/design/04_agent_architecture.md section 4.3; docs/design/05_communication.md section 5.2's topic taxonomy). One event per PreemptionOverlay state transition for one junction on one run -- acquired/released, not the run's overall state (which is PreemptionOverlay.get_run's concern, not a bus event).

phase_id.description: Present on lock_acquired: the phase forced for the duration of the lock.
